method_note: V-FOLLOWON-1 repair: a searched field or failed keyword match is not proof of absence. Each entry records the exact searched scope, the literal queries/reads actually run, any counterevidence found with exact locators, and the limits of what the miss proves. Where evidence is insufficient the dispute is left UNRESOLVED rather than denied. Corpus for N-01..N-04 and N-07..N-30 is the frozen S003 capture (capture-only:5d8b240877ed2cf9596566187bcb3779ea011d5319807134c65e2e7dc2ae82de, 36980 bytes, 896 lines, https://ngff.openmicroscopy.org/0.5/). Corpus for N-05/N-06/N-30 is the stated fixture or the session itself.

checks.absence_claim: No Zarr-feature disallowance is stated anywhere in the capture (re S003 L70-72 'unless explicitly disallowed').
queries_reads: literal search 'disallow' over S003 (hit: L72 only)
literal-substring searches 'codec' (hit L70 only) and 'chunk' (hits L70/L92/L396/L851, none a prohibition)
counterevidence: S003 L72 is itself the 'unless explicitly disallowed' qualifier; no second sentence exercising that qualifier was found.
checks.limits: Proves only that the literal term 'disallow' occurs solely at L72 and that the corroborating reads found no prohibition. A paraphrased restriction using other wording (e.g. 'MUST NOT use codec X') would not match 'disallow'; the full-text reads mitigate but do not eliminate that risk. Paraphrase-free corpus-wide denial is NOT claimed (see NF-02).

checks.absence_claim: §4 'Implementations — See Tools' (L813-814) and §5 Citing (L815-820) carry no implementation requirements; the Tools pointer is the whole implementation text in scope.
checks.section_scope: whole capture for pointer terms (L1-896); close read L810-820 (naming + implementations + citing)
queries_reads: literal search 'Implementations' (hits L42 TOC, L61 transitional, L813 heading)
literal search 'Citing' (hits L43 TOC, L815 heading)
counterevidence: None found: L813-814 is the two-line block '4. Implementations / See Tools.'; L815-820 is citation boilerplate (title, authors, editions, doi) with no MUST/SHOULD/MAY.
checks.limits: Proves the pointer-section text contains no requirements. Does not rule out implementation guidance paraphrased elsewhere under unsearched terms; N-24 covers the wider behavioral searches.

checks.absence_claim: Interoperability with real OME-Zarr 0.5 tool outputs is not evidenced inside S003; the brief's 'actual reader implementations' goal is unresolvable in this scope.
counterevidence: None found: no tool names, versions, outputs, fixtures, or reader-tolerance sentences located.
checks.limits: Scoped to admitted S003 text. Real-world interop may be satisfiable by conformance alone; the report claims only lack of in-scope evidence, not incompatibility. Left as scope limitation (§9), not a denial of real-world behavior.

checks.absence_claim: Nothing in S003 requires a viewer to write; the source never blesses mutating zarr.json/chunks during viewing (read-side silence).
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'writ' (hits L26 editor-draft 'data written', L62-63 transitional 'writing will usually be optional')
counterevidence: S003 L60-64 (transitional writers MAY) and L26 ('data written with an editor's draft') are the only write-related sentences; both cut against a viewer write obligation.
checks.limits: Literal-substring 'writ' catches write/writes/writing/written but not paraphrases like 'modify/persist/store results'. The full reads found no such viewer-mutation sentence, but paraphrase-free denial is not claimed. Claim is used only to support plan-compatibility (KEEP), not to forbid session-local writes outside the fileset.

checks.absence_claim: The thin plan names none of the three fileset shapes (single image / HCS plate / bioformats2raw collection).
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'image' over Viewer.md (hits L5/L7/L11, all flat 'images it finds' language)
counterevidence: None found: L5 'opens a local OME-Zarr 0.5 fileset and lists the images it finds' is the sole discovery sentence.
checks.limits: Plan-scope absence (11 lines fully read), not a source claim. Exhaustive for this fixture; trivially re-checkable by reading Viewer.md L5.

checks.absence_claim: The plan has no multi-multiscales concept.
queries_reads: full read R-07; 'multiscales' occurs nowhere in the 11-line plan (corroborated by the N-05 reads)
counterevidence: None found.
checks.limits: Plan-scope absence over a fully-read 11-line fixture. Exhaustive.

checks.absence_claim: The value '3' of bioformats2raw.layout is unexplained in S003.
checks.section_scope: whole capture for the key (L1-896); close read §2.2 L175-275
counterevidence: L200 and L213 show the value 3 in examples; L256 mandates 'MUST have the value "3"'. No sentence defines what 3 enumerates or what other values would mean.
checks.limits: Proves no explanation adjacent to any key occurrence or in §2.2. A distant rationale using neither the key name nor 'layout' would not match; the full §2.2 read mitigates this. Adopted reading (accept-only-3) is the conservative consequence.

checks.absence_claim: The multi-multiscales name/fallback rule (L388-397) carries no RFC 2119 keyword.
queries_reads: literal search 'If only one multiscale' (hit L388, confirms passage)

close read S003 L388-397: 'If only one multiscale is provided, use it. Otherwise, the user can choose by name, using the first multiscale as a fallback:' + name-match loop + 'Use the first by default. Or perhaps choose based on chunk size.'
counterevidence: None found in-passage: no MUST/MUST NOT/SHALL/SHOULD/MAY/REQUIRED/RECOMMENDED/OPTIONAL token in L388-397.
checks.limits: Passage-scoped only. A keyword in surrounding §2.4 prose could in principle govern the passage; the close read of L295-319 found the MUSTs there do not extend to the L388 fallback. Normative force left unresolved; implemented as the only stated rule.

checks.absence_claim: Row groups have no metadata section in S003; rows are discoverable only via plate.rows + plate.wells[].path.
checks.section_scope: whole capture, L1-896 (TOC + all §2.x sections + hierarchy text)
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'row' (hits: L124-128 hierarchy, L134-148 sketch, L224/L229/L542-560/L562/L597/L607-633/L698/L726-733 definitions+examples, L845 history)
counterevidence: Positive evidence for the second half: plate.rows definition L542-549 and wells path/index triple L552-560 fully determine row identity. No §2.x 'row' section, no row-group zarr.json key, and no row-version key found.
checks.limits: A row rule filed under an unsearched heading without the substring 'row' is theoretically possible; the TOC + full reads mitigate this. The 'never by scanning directories alone' corollary is inference (N-29), not a quoted MUST.

checks.absence_claim: 'Largest → smallest' dataset ordering (L306) has no metric in S003.
checks.section_scope: whole capture, L1-896; close read §2.4 L295-319
queries_reads: literal searches 'largest' (hit L306 only), 'smallest' (hit L306 only), 'MUST be ordered from largest' (hit L306 only)
counterevidence: L306 parenthetical '(i.e. highest resolution)' is the only gloss; no pixel-count/extent/shape formula accompanies it.
checks.limits: Proves no metric adjacent to the ordering rule and no 'metric' sentence anywhere. A metric described without size vocabulary in a distant section would not match; the §2.4 close read mitigates this. Adopted voxel-count sanity check (flag, never reorder) is a product decision.

checks.absence_claim: The source imposes no threading/background/responsiveness mechanism.
counterevidence: None found. Data-scale premises exist (chunked arrays L91-100, unbounded features L70-72) but no mechanism sentence.
checks.limits: Keyword misses prove only those searches. 'responsive/cancel/async/task' were not separately searched as S003 substrings; mitigation: the full R-05/R-06 reads encountered no mechanism passage, and N-24 extends the behavioral sweep. Mechanism left as product decision; outcome required by brief/plan.

checks.absence_claim: No channel-unit vocabulary is given in S003.
checks.section_scope: §2.1 axes L166-174 plus whole-capture unit sweep (L1-896)
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'unit' (hits: L170 rule, L171 space list, L172 time list, L310-311 physical units, L330-334/L370 example, L842 history; no channel list)
counterevidence: L171 'Units for space axes: ...' and L172 'Units for time axes: ...' are exhaustive on their face; the example channel axis (L331) carries no unit.
checks.limits: Proves the enumerated vocabulary covers space/time only. A channel-unit sentence avoiding the substring 'unit' is implausible but not keyword-disproven; the §2.1 close read corroborates. Unknown/missing units handled by lenient display rule (F-26).

checks.absence_claim: omero siblings (active, coefficient, family, inverted, label, rdefs/defaultT/defaultZ/model) are example-only; they appear nowhere in normative MUST text.
checks.section_scope: §2.5 omero L398-430 (example L401-423, normative L426-430) verified by whole-capture searches (L1-896)
queries_reads: literal searches 'active' (hit L405 only), 'coefficient' (L406 only), 'family' (L408 only), 'inverted' (L409 only), 'rdefs' (L419 only), 'defaultT' (L420 only)
literal-substring 'color' (example L407/L422 + normative L427 + image-label L457-468/L483)
read S003 L398-430 + fencing rule L877-883
counterevidence: Normative L426-430 requires only channels/color/window{min,max,start,end}; none of the sibling keys recurs there. (Sibling 'label' was verified by the L398-430 close read rather than a separate keyword search.)
checks.limits: Whole-capture single-occurrence proof for the six searched siblings is strong. 'label'/'defaultZ'/'model' rest on the close read, not separate searches — noted honestly. Best-effort (never required) handling adopted.

checks.absence_claim: omero.channels-to-channel-extent length correspondence is not a stated MUST; it appears only as the L403 example comment.
queries_reads: literal-substring 'channel' (hits incl. L403 comment 'Array matching the c dimension size', L426-428 normative without length rule)
counterevidence: L403 comment text confirms the correspondence exists as a comment; L426-430 impose no length MUST.
checks.limits: A length rule phrased without 'channel/array/size/length' would not match; the §2.5 close read mitigates this. Overlap-degrade handling adopted; neither side treated as authoritative.

checks.absence_claim: No normative color/window semantics exist beyond field presence: no gamma/family registry, no out-of-range rule.
checks.section_scope: whole capture, L1-896; close read L426-430
counterevidence: L427 (6-hex RGB format) and L428-430 (min/max/start/end presence) are the complete normative semantics found.
checks.limits: Keyword misses prove only those searches. 'range/clamp/normalize' were not separately searched; mitigation: §2.5 close read found no further semantics. Out-of-range/malformed values handled as malformed-input messages, not crashes.

checks.absence_claim: Absent omero, S003 supplies no embedded rendering defaults; all rendering state is a product decision.
checks.section_scope: §2.5 L398-430 (optionality + MUSTs) plus whole-capture default sweep
queries_reads: read S003 L426 ('The omero metadata is optional ...')
counterevidence: L426 optionality sentence directly supports the claim; no second defaults source (e.g. fallback palette, default contrast) was found in the §2.5 read.
checks.limits: Rests on the §2.5 close read plus the N-13/N-15 keyword sweeps. A defaults sentence in a distant section is unlikely (rendering defaults belong to §2.5) but not keyword-disproven. Sensible-defaults + 'no embedded display defaults' disclosure adopted.

checks.absence_claim: The translation 'origin' (L311) is never defined in S003.
queries_reads: literal search 'origin' (hits: L311 'offset from the origin' + L105/L110/L435/L437/L455/L472 'original' substrings)
counterevidence: L311 is both the sole 'origin' sentence and the definiendum itself; no companion 'the origin is ...' sentence found.
checks.limits: A definition avoiding the word 'origin' (e.g. 'translations are relative to the image group') would not match; the §§2.3-2.4 close reads found no such sentence. Image-group-frame reading adopted and labeled as assumption.

checks.absence_claim: Binary-path scale/translation (L285-289) has no dtype/shape/endianness rule in S003.
queries_reads: literal search 'binary' (hits L286/L289 only: 'stored either as a list of floats ... or as binary data at a location in this container (path)')
counterevidence: L286/L289 length rule ('The length of vector defines number of dimensions') is the only accompanying constraint; no dtype, shape, layout, or endianness sentence found.
checks.limits: Keyword set covers the natural vocabulary; a rule phrased as 'byte order' or 'array layout' would not match. The §2.3 close read corroborates. Unsupported-input handling adopted unless the Zarr backend resolves the path.

checks.absence_claim: image-label.version, plate.version, and well.version vocabularies are unspecified beyond 'MUST be a string'.
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'version' (27 hits incl. L459-460 image-label, L550-551 plate, L751-752 well; all 'MUST be a string specifying the version of the ... schema/specification' with no value enumeration)
counterevidence: The three MUST-be-a-string sentences are themselves the complete vocabulary text found; the skimage 'version 0.16.1' (L379) and history entries are unrelated.
checks.limits: Exhaustive for the 'version' substring; a vocabulary list filed without the word 'version' is implausible. Accept-any-string-and-display adopted; never gate on these values.

checks.absence_claim: Whether a label image's own axes/transforms or the parent's govern alignment when both exist is unstated in S003.
queries_reads: read S003 L432-433 ('same coordinate system ... usually ...')
counterevidence: L432-433 proximity statement and L454 multiscales MUST both exist but neither assigns precedence; no 'label transforms take precedence' or converse sentence found.
checks.limits: Rests on close reads rather than a distinctive keyword (precedence vocabulary varies). 'Label's own transforms, verified against parent's, warn on divergence' adopted and labeled as assumption. Left unresolved.

checks.absence_claim: S003 states no interpolation/resampling rule for label overlays.
counterevidence: Categorical-value premises exist (integer dtypes L438-439, 0/1 cellular example L434-435/L513-514) but no resampling sentence.
checks.limits: Keyword misses prove only those searches. 'sample/filter/render' were not separately searched; mitigation: §2.6 close read found no rendering-method sentence. Nearest-neighbor recorded explicitly as product decision justified by the integer-label contract, not as a source MUST.

checks.absence_claim: The 'if multiple acquisitions were performed' trigger (L748-749) is ambiguous; no clarifier found (acquisitions-list length vs referenced-id count).
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'acquisition' (27 hits incl. L518-529 block, L748-750 trigger+MUST, L754/L765-777/L786/L797-801 examples)
counterevidence: L748-749 trigger + L749-750 match-an-id MUST are the complete rule text; examples show 1-, 2-, and 4-acquisition plates without stating which counts as 'multiple ... performed'.
checks.limits: Ambiguity claims need only the rule text itself; the sweep confirms no clarifier uses the 'acquisition' vocabulary. A clarifier avoiding that vocabulary is unlikely. Lenient reading adopted (>1-entry requires, honor-wherever-present, dangling-id message).

checks.absence_claim: field_count vs maximumfieldcount semantics are not further distinguished beyond their one-sentence definitions.
queries_reads: literal search 'field_count' (hits L228 example, L538-539 rule 'maximum number of fields per view across all wells', L595/L696 examples)
literal search 'maximumfieldcount' (hits L524-525 rule 'maximum number of fields of view for the acquisition', L573/L579/L653 examples)
counterevidence: The two one-sentence definitions overlap ('maximum number of fields ...'); no cross-reference or precedence sentence found.
checks.limits: Exhaustive for both literal keys. Display-hints-only adopted for both; neither used as a discovery key.

checks.absence_claim: No reader-tolerance, performance, caching, or error-handling behavior is specified anywhere in the capture.
queries_reads: literal-substring 'reader' (hits L271/L271-275 collections, L461 labels — display/multiplicity only, no tolerance text)
counterevidence: The only two 'reader' sentences (L271-275, L461) concern multiplicity awareness and label colors, not tolerance/performance/caching/errors.
checks.limits: Keyword misses prove only those searches; a paraphrased behavioral sentence using none of the searched stems would not match (see NF-01). The full-text reads encountered no such passage, but paraphrase-free denial is NOT claimed. Used only to bound §9 as a scope limitation.

checks.absence_claim: No worked multi-axis global-composition example exists beyond the time-axis case (L368-374).
checks.section_scope: §2.4 example L320-387 plus whole-capture composition sweep
queries_reads: read S003 L320-387 (per-level scales L339-365 + global L368-374 time-only [0.1,1,1,1,1])
counterevidence: L368-374 global scale touches only the time axis (0.1 vs 1.0 elsewhere); no second global example found in the §2.4 read.
checks.limits: Example-scoped. Outer∘inner composition is the only reading consistent with 'applied after' (L315) + sequential application (L293); multi-axis behavior beyond time left unresolved.

checks.absence_claim: Label-alignment 'usually' (L433) plus the overview-only broadcast rule (L106-108) leave normative force uncertain; no stronger alignment MUST found.
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'usually' (hits L62 transitional + L433 alignment)
read S003 L102-108 ('should be either the same ... or 1') and L432-433 ('same coordinate system ... usually ...')
counterevidence: L106 'should' (lowercase, overview) and L433 'usually' are the complete alignment-strength vocabulary found; L454-455 impose level-count, not geometric, equality.
checks.limits: Strength assessment rests on modal vocabulary in the two passages. Level-locked + broadcast-aware rendering with mismatch warnings adopted; silent stretching forbidden by product rule, not by a quoted MUST.

checks.absence_claim: Beyond 'MUST be consistent' (L156), S003 states no mixed-version-hierarchy remediation (hard error vs best-effort).
checks.section_scope: §2.0 version block L150-165 plus whole-capture version sweep
queries_reads: literal-substring search 'version' (27 hits; consistency rule L156 is the sole remediation-adjacent sentence)
counterevidence: L156 consistency MUST with no accompanying 'if violated, ...' sentence; L25-27 editor's-draft note covers drafts, not mixed 0.5 hierarchies.
checks.limits: A remediation sentence avoiding 'version/consistent/mismatch' would not match; the §2.0 close read mitigates this. Hard-error vs caveat left as product decision with Viewer.md L7 message required either way.

checks.absence_claim: The L93-94 line-wrap repetition has no semantic effect (editorial artifact, not a second ordering rule).
queries_reads: read S003 L91-94: L93 '... ordering defined by' + L94 '# by the "multiscales" metadata, but is often a sequence starting at 0.'
counterevidence: The wrap yields 'defined by / by the' ('by by the'); the normative ordering rule is independently stated at L305-306, so no meaning turns on the comment wording. Corrects candidate phrasing 'by the by the' (RPL-02).
checks.limits: Comment-scoped. No format behavior depends on this wording under either reading.

checks.absence_claim: No explicit S003 sentence prohibits metadata-less directory enumeration for discovery (candidate's 'non-conforming discovery' is inference).
counterevidence: Discovery is defined exclusively through metadata keys (series-or-numbered L268-270, plate→well L552-560/L744-750, multiscales order L305-306); no sentence addresses directory scanning at all — neither permitting nor forbidding it.
checks.limits: Absence of a prohibition is itself a scoped negative: a 'MUST NOT scan/enumerate' sentence using unsearched verbs would not match. The report therefore retains metadata-driven discovery as near-obligation-by-definition while labeling the 'non-conforming' verdict as inference (RPL-01), leaving the dispute unresolved as a quoted MUST.

checks.absence_claim: No execution evidence exists for any proposed validation: no filesets opened, no code run, no live fetch performed.
checks.section_scope: this verification session in its entirety
queries_reads: inventory of tool calls in this session: muse.read_file (frozen inputs only), muse.search (local literal/regex over inputs/), muse.write_file/muse.edit_file (out/ artifacts), muse.write_todos, muse.report_progress. No fetch/exec/run/open tool exists in the available toolset; muse.bash execution attempts were denied by sandbox policy and performed nothing.
counterevidence: None: no artifact, log, or output in the session records any fileset open, code execution, or network access.
checks.verdict: confirmed (execution negative is directly auditable from the tool-call record)
checks.limits: Strongest negative in this file: it concerns observable session actions, not corpus paraphrase. Any future execution must be re-recorded; until then all V1-V9 remain UNEXECUTED.

summary: 30/30 absence assertions re-checked with recorded scope/queries. 0 corpus-wide paraphrase-free denials claimed. 2 wordings corrected via RPL-01/RPL-02. All insufficient-evidence disputes left unresolved per method boundary.
